title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package instructions.
Whisk eggs and parmesan together in a bowl.
Combine pasta with pancetta and remove from heat.
Add egg mixture and toss quickly to make a creamy sauce.
Season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and tikka spice for 1 hour.
Prepare sauce with tomato puree and cream.
Add grilled chicken to the sauce and simmer 5 mins.
Serve hot with rice or naan.
